title: South Cambridgeshire - Contact centre chatbot to improve resident satisfaction
summary: South Cambridgeshire reports fewer calls, better routing, and 86–90% approval in chatbot feedback, without evidence of improved representative resident satisfaction.
account: South Cambridgeshire deployed EBI chatbot and call-routing functions to handle routine queries. The council reports fewer calls than in the prior year during the chatbot's first three months and better call classification/routing. No numerical call-volume reduction is supplied. The 93% accuracy figure is a council test result, not independently verified service correctness. Call-volume comparisons do not isolate causality. The source also reports 86–90% approval from thumbs-up/thumbs-down feedback, without a response count or satisfaction baseline.
purpose: Resolve routine queries and route contacts so that staff can focus on more complex needs.
system: EBI.AI chatbot, live chat, AI interactive voice response, and planned voicebot functions

ratings.reason: The council reports reduced routine-call demand and better routing, supporting modest operational efficiency.
Officers receive more calls on the correct topics, reducing routine friction. Improved resident satisfaction is an aim rather than a reported result.

ai_role.statement: The deployed chatbot and routing functions answer or classify routine contacts. The council reports fewer calls, better routing, and 86–90% approval from thumbs-up/thumbs-down feedback. Year-on-year comparisons do not isolate causality, and the feedback measure does not establish an improvement in resident satisfaction.

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
